hints.title: Nine Cell Window Neighborhood
hints.text: Each pixel is updated with the floor average of all valid cells in its immediate three-by-three surrounding neighborhood.

hints.title: Neighborhood Boundary Clamping Invariant
hints.text: Pixels on matrix borders have fewer than nine neighbors; only cells strictly within the grid boundaries contribute to sum and count.

hints.title: Local Filter Grid Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a result matrix of size m by n. For each cell (r, c), sum all adjacent cells (nr, nc) within dr, dc in {-1, 0, 1} that fall within bounds. Divide total sum by neighbor count using floor division, and store in result. Return result matrix.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N) time and O(M * N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Mutating the input matrix in place without encoding changes input values for neighboring calculations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting up to 9 cells per pixel runs in 9 * M * N operations, taking O(M * N) time and O(M * N) space for the result.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle corner and edge boundary guards and floor division correctly.
